subject.title: [Feature]: Mattermost — Parity improvements (formatting, reactions, rich interactions)

question: Should OpenClaw expose Mattermost user-presence and read-state events, explicitly document them as unsupported, or continue tracking them only as an open-ended parity goal?
rationale: Mattermost supplies several possible status and read-state events, but repository evidence does not define which are useful, privacy-appropriate, stable across supported servers, or suitable for agent context.

options.title: Split a focused tracker
options.body: Define the intended presence/read-receipt contract in a narrower Mattermost issue and close this umbrella once that issue preserves the remaining scope.

options.title: Explicitly descope them
options.body: Document that Mattermost presence and read receipts are intentionally unsupported and close the umbrella as sufficiently complete.

options.title: Keep the umbrella
options.body: Continue using this broad issue as the roadmap tracker for all future Mattermost parity improvements.

recommendation.title: Split a focused tracker
recommendation.body: Define the intended presence/read-receipt contract in a narrower Mattermost issue and close this umbrella once that issue preserves the remaining scope.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md assigns the Mattermost area to this person, and their recent work directly addresses adjacent interaction feedback behavior.
